Breath of Fire.name: Breath of Fire
Breath of Fire.summary: An enhanced port for the Game Boy Advance handheld system with new save features and minor graphical enhancements, with the English version being released in Europe for the first time.

Densetsu no Stafy.name: Densetsu no Starfy
Densetsu no Stafy.summary: In the beginning, Starfy was moving things around Pufftop Palace, until he tripped and dropped some things he was moving. One of them fell into the ocean, which was the Magic Jar, an object that seals the evil being known as Ogura.

Kiwame Mahjong Deluxe - Mirai Senshi 21.name: Kiwame Mahjong Deluxe: Mirai Senshi 21
Kiwame Mahjong Deluxe - Mirai Senshi 21.summary: Goku Mahjong Deluxe: Mirai Senshi 21 is a Miscellaneous game, published by Athena, which was released in Japan in 2001.

Spider-Man - Battle for New York.name: Spider-Man: Battle for New York
Spider-Man - Battle for New York.summary: Spider-Man: Battle for New York allows players to take on the role of Spider-Man and one of his famed nemeses, Green Goblin. For the first time in a handheld Spider-Man game, players can personalize their experiences by choosing what abilities and powers to upgrade and when, such as Spider-Man’s web manoeuvres or Green Goblin’s fire attacks.

Zoids Saga.name: Zoids Saga
Zoids Saga.summary: Zoids Saga is a Role-Playing game, developed by Amedio and published by Tomy Corporation, which was released in Japan in 2001.
